cues.en: Sir.
Alright. Well, I've had two points and a big flat one. Can I have a flat one, mom? Sorry,
cues.zh: 好吧。我得了两个点和一个大扁饼。妈妈，能给我一个大扁饼吗？对不起，

cues.en: dad. Alright.
Two points, two flats, a packet of gravel. Packet of gravel.
cues.zh: 两个点，两个大扁饼，一袋碎石。一袋碎石。

cues.en: Should be a good one this afternoon. Local boy. Oh, good.
cues.zh: 今天下午应该会很精彩。是本地小伙子。哦，太好了。

cues.en: Enjoy yourselves.
Mathers, son of Deuteronomy of Gath. Do I say yes? Yes. Yes. You have been found guilty by the elders of the town
cues.zh: Mathers，Gath的Deuteronomy之子。我该说「是」吗？是。是。镇上的长老认定你有罪，

cues.en: of uttering the name of our lord,
cues.zh: 罪名是说出了我主的名号，

cues.en: and so as a blasphemer.
You are to be stoned to death. Look.
I had a lovely supper, and all I said to my wife was that piece of Hanifa was good enough for Jehovah.
cues.zh: 我吃了一顿美餐，我就跟我妻子说了句，那块哈利法鱼配得上耶和华享用。

cues.en: Bless for me. He said
Are there any women here today?
cues.zh: 今天这里有女人在场吗？

cues.en: Very well. By virtue of the authority
vested in me Oh,
lay off. We haven't started yet. Come on. Who threw that?
cues.zh: 住手。我们还没开始呢。搞什么。谁扔的？

cues.en: Who threw that stone? Come on.
cues.zh: 刚那块石头是谁扔的？说啊。

cues.en: Sorry.
I thought we started.
Go to the back.
Oh, dear. Always one, isn't there?
cues.zh: 天哪。总有这种显眼包，对吧？

cues.en: Now where were we? Look. I don't think it ought to be blasphemy.
cues.zh: 我们刚才说到哪儿了？听着，我不认为这算亵渎。

cues.en: Just saying, Jehovah.
But you're only making it worse for yourself. Making it worse. How could it be worse?
cues.zh: 但你只会让自己更惨。更惨。还能怎么更惨？

cues.en: Jehovah,
Jehovah,
I'm warning you. If you say Jehovah once more, strike.
cues.zh: 我警告你。你要是再说一次耶和华，就劈了你。

cues.en: Who threw that?
Come on. Who threw that? Was
it you? Yes.
Right. We did say Jehovah.
cues.zh: 好。我们确实说了耶和华。

cues.en: Will you put that?
Come in. Now look. No one
cues.zh: 进来。听着。在我吹哨之前，

cues.en: is to stone anyone
until I blow this whistle. Do you understand?
Even... And I wanna make this absolutely clear.
cues.zh: 即便如此……我也想把这点说得清清楚楚。

cues.en: Even if they do say Jehovah.
cues.zh: 即便他们说的是耶和华。

cues.en: God, stop.
